capacity:slow.title: Reports can't keep up
capacity:slow.message: At the diagram's own rates, it gets 6/s and handles 0.67/s (900%): its backlog only grows.
capacity:slow.rationale: Demand above what a service can handle never drains: latency and backlog grow until something times out. Live view's Show capacity has the same numbers.
